text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Is it over...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't think of anything... My mind 
went totally blank. But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I gave it my all. I really did it, 
right? My run, my feelings... I'm sure 
they reached everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So that wraps up the first race of the 
afternoon. Kitasan Black gave it a good 
shot.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now then, the fun really starts from 
here. As for the next race...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ehh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so frustrated...! How should 
I put it... I was really put in my place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although her running was up to par, 
Kitasan Black wore a gloomy expression 
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First of all, the level of their running 
was totally different. I knew it 
beforehand, but the real Twinkle Series is 
completely on another level...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The pace was so fast, and the pressure was 
on a whole other level, so all I could do 
was run with reckless abandon!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If I let my guard down even a little, or 
if something goes wrong, it feels like I 
could suffer a devastating loss in an 
instant...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So this is the "terror of a one-shot 
battle" that my father and his apprentices 
talked about.
choice_data_list: The fear of a one-shot showdown?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She always used to say: "The stage is 
always a one-shot deal, and you never know 
what might happen. That's what makes it so 
scary, and so fun."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Races and singing are different, but this 
must be what my dad and the others were 
talking about.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing. I ran as hard as I 
could in my own way, but I realized that 
alone just isn't enough!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I mean, none of the spectators today were 
happy or moved by my running anyway~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Running like just anyone could do it. I 
can't make anyone smile like this! Talk 
about not making the cut... ughhh~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black realized just how far away 
her goal truly was and bit her lip in 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, this is a step that everyone 
goes through. It's not entirely a bad 
thing by any means."
choice_data_list: Let's build up step by step from here!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right...! I already knew I 
still have a long way to go, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it doesn't seem like things will 
progress in leaps and bounds as easily as 
I'd thought. I suppose that's the way of 
racing.”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! What I lack is ability! Without 
ability, far from making people smile, I 
won't even catch their eye. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next year, before the Classic Triple 
Crown, I just want to build up my strength 
as much as possible.
choice_data_list:
Alright, then let's focus on building up 
the basics for a while.

Then it's time to patiently put in the 
groundwork for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Paying your dues from the bottom! Yes, 
that's totally it! I've seen so many 
people work hard after their debut to 
become full-fledged pros.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be like that too! A journey of 
a thousand miles begins with a single 
step, right!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black has immense potential, and 
because of that, she lacks finesse. Taking 
things slow is definitely the right call 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to carefully nurture her for the 
time being by entering her into suitable 
races.
